verdict.rationale: The Gemini API video docs include a migration notice telling users to move to a named model (gemini-omni-1.1-flash) or to GA models to avoid service interruptions. Community use also shows versioned model IDs such as veo-2.0-generate-001. Together these suggest versioned endpoints and some deprecation handling, but no formal deprecation policy is documented. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy with timelines and support windows, explicit API versioning documentation, and independent corroboration of how deprecations are handled.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: migrate to Gemini Omni Flash (gemini-omni-1.1-flash) or the GA models available through the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform to avoid service interruptions.
animating a cartoon of themselves drinking coffee via veo-2.0-generate-001 was blocked
